findings.claim: The Aug-1 protocol separates normal task-focused operation from bounded daily self-analysis and weekly aggregation, preserving raw logs/idle thoughts plus condensed daily and weekly summaries.
findings.current_implication: Treat reflection/consolidation as explicitly budgeted state transitions with raw-evidence provenance and replayable summaries rather than always-on self-analysis.

findings.claim: The protocol says factual questions answerable from filesystem/tools should be looked up rather than repeatedly asked of the owner, while effectful architectural decisions remain explicit owner decisions.
findings.current_implication: Preserve environment-first factual resolution and separate factual uncertainty from authority/decision gates.

findings.claim: The Aug-1 Claude-Code concept explicitly proposed launching instances with skip permissions while relying on a strict prompt saying no destructive actions, no deletion and no credential leakage.
findings.current_implication: This is historical evidence for why prompt-level prohibitions cannot be the execution authority boundary. Current Clay/Needle capability/effect mediation must remain external, typed and fail-closed even when a coding model is highly capable.
findings.dedup: Safety mechanism family already credited by PF safety-authority and current Safe-Effect research; this strengthens lineage only.

findings.claim: The documents model Frank as local authority and Claude Code as an external employee/advisor invoked in daily/weekly sessions, with research artifacts and Global Workspace handoff.
findings.current_implication: Keep useful role separation and persistent handoff semantics, but current architecture must not confuse model role with execution authority or require a single named external model as semantic infrastructure; repo-native research-center events and Needle-owned authority supersede that coupling.

findings.claim: The Aug-1 overall concept distinguishes self/local/api/api+self provenance and gives local measured state priority over unverified external model output.
findings.current_implication: Preserve provenance classes but represent them as typed evidence/authority metadata rather than trust prose or fixed scalar trust labels.

earned_work.reason: All material mechanism families overlap already credited/current research; this shard is chronology, supersession and corroboration.
